Review completion is not execution approval. Prior line-by-line source work was reused after hash checks; five newer source versions were reconciled separately. Previously completed Willy and BigBeluga reviews are retained. Additional parallel reviews are imported only with matching publication metadata and inspected-source hashes. Unavailable pages, unrelated descriptions and descriptions without meaningful conditions remain explicitly blocked. Substantive author/source contradictions are reviewed findings, not review blockers. For the whole retained library, 2589 of 2626 author publications are reconciled. The separate blocked count includes unavailable pages and descriptions that do not explain conditions. Blocked reviews are not counted as completed reconciliations. Any publication still awaiting inspection is shown separately. Pages were retrieved on 13 November; the reconciliation timestamps do not claim a fresh upstream check today.

Confirmed integration gaps

  • RSI Volume Ladder: the author adds up to three legs and recalculates basket brackets. The bot ignores same-direction adds. A native basket adapter must keep the aggregate $150 budget and risk limits; the current strategy is an adaptation.
  • Absorption Reversal: the source spacing OR can bypass absorption. Lower-timeframe candle delta coverage is also unresolved. Its existing quarantine stays in place.
  • Trend FVG Delta: the author describes discretionary rejection entries; the source draws zones and statistics, not a complete entry condition. Candle-position volume is a proxy.
  • ML RSI classifier and SuperTrend cluster consensus outputs must remain distinct from regime/member flips. The existing comparison variants supply that distinction; generic-reader history is not interchangeable.
  • Trend Impulse continuation, Kinetic's selected marker, Asia-only Killzones and Pivot's long-only reading are deliberate bot variants. Compare alternatives under separate identities.

What changes in the bot

Library → select a script → Author intent and bot reading shows the publication author, reviewed source date, entry conditions, non-entry markers, stop/target/exit logic, timing caveats and current reading. A changed source hides obsolete conditions. Historical claims are scoped to the scanner and labelled as historical; refuted and unchecked claims are excluded. Review records do not change admission, positions, risk or evidence settings. Experimental shadow profiles are enabled separately by a tested operator script; they cannot supply promotion evidence.

Tested shadow rollout

The five available research slots are assigned to author-lifecycle SAVWAP, Synapse and Liquidity Trail, plus exact-direction Pivot Zones and Dynamic Bands signals on ETH 15m. Account enablement stays off. THMA, Liquidity Void, False Breakout, Adaptive Smart Money wick sweeps, Swing Failure, Zone Shift, Zero-Lag MA and Breaker Blocks retest corrections are source-tested and await research capacity. All plans retain $150 margin, the 3% stop ceiling and full research fees. The original 25 experiments and the 30-plan maximum are preserved.

Actual Pine runs on 2,000 historical ETH 15m bars produced entries for all seven reviewed profiles. Fourteen sampled prefix checks agreed without future bars. Three subsequent reading variants produced 22 failed-break entries, 170 qualified wick sweeps and 44 confirmed retests on the same 2,000-bar history; six more prefix checks agreed. Their legacy controls produced 22, 711 and 0 entries respectively. Zone Shift adds 43 confirmed diamonds (0 legacy events), using explicit label-style directions. Swing Failure now reads 18 qualified reversal shapes, excluding its identically named mitigation alerts (36 legacy events). A broader check across all 12 reviewed profiles reran 865 historical prefixes: every observed action bar after warm-up and regularly sampled quiet bars matched without later data. Breaker Blocks adds eight qualified retests after a hash-pinned, variant-only drawing compatibility correction; 22 further prefix checks agree. These totals describe interpretation changes, not improvement in returns. These check event semantics and timing; they do not establish profitability or complete historical depth replay.

The standalone backtest now uses the same configured reading, inputs and account policy as the screen. Native author stop amendments have an explicit after-close replay version; they cannot rewrite that candle’s earlier path. This candle approximation does not reproduce the live engine’s sub-bar stop acknowledgement timing. Other readers retain their earlier replay identity.

Execution work still required

Findings include confirmed discrepancies, integration requirements and interpretation limits; their count is not a count of deployed bugs. Each records the required treatment and is not marked fixed merely because the author review is complete. Reproduce actionable mismatches with real source outputs, then test separate readers or lifecycle adapters on causal fills before shadow admission. Basket adds, stop-entry expiry, scale-outs, external series and per-pattern invalidation require explicit adapters. Existing account adaptations keep their evidence identity. Context-only publications remain useful as context and should not be forced to generate entries. Blocked author explanations require additional primary evidence.
